translation_of: observable_dof.json (Japanese, authoritative; its SHA-256 is recorded in the results). This file is an English translation made on 2026-10-25, after the computation, and has no effect on it.
purpose: Compute numerically the rank of the map from the inputs (two: V, A; hypothetically three: V, A, D) to the height map before normalisation, to the exported (min-max) height map, and to the pair of descriptors, and compare the observable degrees of freedom. The third input D is the minimal one that moves gamma alone; it is not designed as an improvement of the rule.
fixed_before_running: This list was written before the computation. Conditions added or removed after seeing results are explained in this section.

maps.name: three_inputs
maps.rule: Eqs. (1)-(3) plus gamma <- gamma + 0.3 D (D in [-1, 1]); f and s unchanged. The coefficient 0.3 does not affect the rank.

generator: Default of atact.field (four octaves, no warp, maxabs, N = 128). H = s T_gamma(F) (as atact.field.height).

outputs.name: H
outputs.rule: All pixels of the height map before normalisation.

outputs.name: minmax
outputs.rule: All pixels of the exported height map (H - min) / (max - min).

outputs.name: desc_H
outputs.rule: (Rq, centroid) on H (eqs. (5) and (6) of Harada (2026); atact.descriptors.rq and centroid).

outputs.name: desc_minmax
outputs.rule: (Rq, centroid) on the exported height map.

points_note: (V, A, D). The two-input map does not use D. Includes a point where f is an integer (A = 0, f = 5) and points where it is not.
jacobian: Central differences with step 1e-4 (input units). Singular values divided by the largest; the number above 1e-6 is the rank.
predictions: Two inputs: H 2, minmax 2, desc_H 2, desc_minmax 2 (Proposition 1; V survives the export through gamma).
Three inputs: H 3, minmax 2, desc_H 2, desc_minmax 2 (Proposition 4: the export removes s, leaving (f, gamma); with two descriptors the rank is at most 2).
The null direction of minmax for three inputs is the input direction that changes s alone without changing (f, gamma) (moving V and cancelling the change of gamma with D).
